title: USB Connector Comparison
description: Two plug shapes, six callouts, and a flip control that shows exactly why one of them fits either way up.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Robots, USB Basics, and Electronics Workshop Skills

educational.audience: Mentors buying and sorting club cables

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a USB-A and a USB-C connector drawn side by side, the learner differentiates the two by shape, orientation, and typical power/data capability.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click any numbered callout for its explanation; flip either plug and see whether it still fits
pedagogical.assessment: Ask which plug is which end of a cable, and why USB-C has no answer to that.
